snippet.title: Rendagor new GamePlay Trailer
snippet.description:
Rendagor is a 2D topdown shooter starring a Rendagor Corp service robot, just another robot...or maybe not?

Explore the different story and mode maps to discover the secrets of Rendagor Corp. 
Or try your hand at the single-levels arcade mode.

Either way, shoot, beat 'n blast enemies or the game environment with a large set of weaponry.

Try the free alpha demo on steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372070?utm_source=ytube
